metadata.purpose: Full-population ownership policy for unattended runtime writers of Git-tracked paths.

remote_triggers.items.reason: Both remote triggers are disabled compatibility declarations; they do not execute a local writer.

daily_planning.reason: A prompt-driven session may materialize queue work; the agent/supervisor delivery path owns the resulting exact paths.

continue_task.reason: The session dispatches normal agents and remediation; PHASE-Z owns machine state and each agent owns its declared deliverables.

platform_patrol.reason: Prompt-driven findings become queue rows or normal agent work, not an unattended static writer.

git_sync.reason: The session is an explicit Git maintainer and may only commit already-attributed work after inspecting status.

knowledge_index_check.reason: The fixed index freshness ledger is scheduled machine state; the index database itself is ignored.

token_usage_daily.reason: Daily and weekly token reports already sit inside the token-usage PHASE-Z namespace.

ndc_indicator_refresh.reason: The scheduled check is read-only; a stale result explicitly expands into an agent-reviewed manual update.

codex_quota_resume_2026_04_24.reason: Past-dated one-shot prompt; any replay uses the normal queue and agent delivery contracts.

journal_topic_scan.reason: Authored research planning is reviewed and committed by the spawned agent/session; it must never be adopted as machine state.

event_jobs.items.reason: Each template first materializes PHASE-Z queue/ledger state; the later content agent owns and commits its declared article outputs.

idle_policy.reason: Selection policy only; it has no executable entrypoint.

log_rotate.reason: Only rotates ignored cron and ~/.volpred log files.

codex_update.reason: Updates the external npm installation and may send a notification; repository outputs are logs only.

arxiv_scan.reason: Candidate staging is scheduled machine state under storage/research/.

collect_tw_data.reason: The only tracked path opened by the job is a permanently empty flock sentinel; touch/flock changes no Git-tracked bytes. All market data outputs are ignored.

collect_us_data.reason: The Monday FRED branch rewrites tracked macro CSVs and now guards and commits only its clean-before-write paths.

daily_update.reason: The morning writer has both parent-repo and nested-frontend tracked outputs; each Git root is guarded and committed separately.

daily_update_intraday.reason: The intraday wrapper invokes the same guarded writer as the morning job.

radar_strategy_snapshot.reason: Writes the Supabase radar_strategy_snapshots table only.

release_pool.reason: Cadence release mutates the canonical feed, which is an exact PHASE-Z machine-state file.

market_calendar_sync.reason: Writes ignored storage/market_status.json and Supabase state.

shared_scheduler_tick.reason: Scheduler state, event ledgers, and materialized queue rows are declared machine state.

check_alerts.reason: Direct state is PHASE-Z-owned; due jobs retain their own row policy, and compute/lazypack outputs use exact output_paths in the central reaper.

memory_health_daily.reason: Reads memory state and emits ignored notification/log output only.

dreaming_review.reason: Dreaming findings and baseline are scheduled ops state; proposed governance edits are never applied by this job.

publication_candidates_refresh.reason: The derived publication candidate pool is an exact PHASE-Z machine-state file.

refresh_paper_snapshots.reason: Paper data is authored/reproducibility output outside machine-state boundaries, so the writer guards and commits exact refreshed CSVs.

release_settings_audit.reason: Reads ignored storage/.release_settings.json and patches Supabase only.

paper_sync_all.reason: Scheduled PDF mirroring writes a separate frontend Git repository; sync_all_papers guards and commits only its five mapped public PDFs there.

populate_events_weekly.reason: The generated event schedule is authored config outside PHASE-Z; staged and unstaged pre-existing edits both block adoption.

digest_daily_enqueue.reason: Only materializes a pending digest task.

question_research.reason: Question maintenance writes queue and ops receipts; the later member task owns article output.

reader_facing_refill.reason: Refill writes the pending queue and scan state only.

work_summary_6h.reason: Reads work/feed state and sends an ignored notification; no tracked report is persisted.

audit_publish_sync.reason: Audit is read-only apart from logs/notifications.

audit_fb_pipeline.reason: The audit conditionally auto-expires stale Facebook rows by invoking the tracked feed status writer.

fb_ttl_expire.reason: The scheduled --auto-expire invocation mutates feed status only; draft creation is unreachable in that invocation.

ops_dashboard.reason: Dashboard snapshot is ignored; the scheduled render does not invoke the interactive task-mutation endpoint.

boss_report_4h.reason: Renders to /tmp and sends a notification.

gmail_poll.reason: Poller writes queue rows and inbox state only.

telegram_poll.reason: Poller writes queue rows and telegram state only.

handoff_regen.reason: Handoff and stale-claim cleanup are machine queue/ops state.

supabase_sync_drain.reason: The queue is shared PHASE-Z machine state, but the drain also performs an ownership-safe immediate commit so resolved rows do not wait for the next dispatch.

indicator_arena_daily.reason: Forward signal/review ledgers are scheduled machine state.

codex_work_log_backfill.reason: The wrapper checks target status before mutation and commits with --only plus the exact work_log path.

git_push_backup.reason: Reads/audits the checkout and pushes existing commits; it does not generate repository state.

backup_user_claude.reason: The scheduled user-level mirror has no session author and its exact root is PHASE-Z machine state.

token_report_daily.reason: The scheduled no-argument invocation sends a notification; config/token_quota_calibration.json is written only by the manual --calibrate mode.

reader_metrics_daily.reason: Reader snapshots are scheduled analytics machine state.

reader_preferences.reason: The weekly preference analysis derives from the same reader snapshots and writes only its own analytics artifacts; it runs no git command of its own.

daily_checkup.reason: Daily result-level health reports and alert receipts are scheduled operations machine state.

market_closure_detect.reason: Emergency closure config is authored state outside PHASE-Z and is committed only when clean before detection.

volpred-hourly-dispatch.reason: LaunchAgent is disabled; the wrapper is a one-command rollback artifact. The active supervisor owns delivery.

volpred-compute-worker.reason: Each job records literal output_paths; check_alerts invokes the single reaper owner, which collision-checks and commits with --only.

fred_backfill_guard.reason: The guard delegates to _collect_fred, whose shared implementation now guards and commits every refreshed series.

volpred-dispatch-supervisor.reason: Supervisor state is machine-owned; each fire takes a pre-fire dirty snapshot and PHASE-Z commits only fire-owned or declared machine paths.

com.volpred.work-dashboard.reason: Host-only UI daemon is not periodic; its only repository mutation is a human POST delegated to mark_task_blocked.py for PHASE-Z-owned storage/next_tasks.json.
